title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The 'Protection et moyens de Subsistances (Protection and Livelihoods)' project in the territories of Masisi and Lubero in the Democratic Republic of Congo, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will directly reach 24,000 people working within 6 communities most affected by armed conflicts qualified in the 2022 OCHA humanitarian response plan. Oxfam will work with partners Solidarité pour la Promotion Sociale et la Paix (SOPROP) and Fédération des Producteurs Agricoles du Congo (FOPAC-NK) to deliver strategy that aims to contribute to peace, stability, poverty reduction and the protection of civilians through interventions aimed at strengthening the capacities of communities to overcome the crises and challenges arising from them.. OUTCOME: IMPACT 4: People experiencing poverty, conflict and most vulnerable to shocks are better served by a nexus approach to HR, peace building and development. SPECIFIC OUTCOME:
